# Shlok Alva

> Official portfolio for Shlok Alva, focused on robotics, aerospace, CAD, software, embedded systems, aircraft propulsion, and hands-on engineering projects.

Canonical URL: https://shlokalva.com/

## About

I am Shlok Alva. This site is my first-person engineering portfolio and project record.

## Projects

- Little Helper — a track-based teacher book-carrying robot developed from CAD through electronics, code, and physical testing.
- Team Dinoco — my National Robotics League robotics work, including team captaincy, mechanical build work, coordination, strategy, and competition preparation.
- Aircraft Propulsion Internship — my Dwello Aerospace internship work involving ramjet and turbofan CAD, calculations, simulation, animation, and technical reporting.
- Trinetra — my wearable-tech CAD and mechanism-design project.
- Self-Made RC Plane — my scratch-built aviation project using a NACA 0012 airfoil and iterative design.

## Areas of Focus

Robotics, aerospace, aircraft propulsion, CAD, mechanical design, 3D printing, embedded systems, software development, and engineering project documentation.
